challenge.better_approach: Holding the tester in the far bus process would make the far home hold a shim, which bc0bbfd33a71 refuses by design (the LAN door answers only call, stats and verbs). Taking the reply in the requesting process is what 6b1e13704e17 did for Bus.request.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That codemother's reply is posted before _announce_seals reads, because the far bus fires her hook inside post. A reply posted later is taken by the next seal run, since the read takes every standing reply to tester.
challenge.prior_art: 6b1e13704e17 (a requester takes its reply: record_delivery for the requester); cff5a197b3c4 (the tester shim takes its reply when wired). Neither covers a far home where nothing is wired.
challenge.real_collision: None: the tester's own mail is the tester's (Law 6); bus_client/remote.py is not touched.

answers.falsifier: Done: with codemother wired and the tester wired nowhere, a seal announcement leaves undelivered(to='tester') empty, receipted by tester, and prints the refused line. Wrong: the far bus home does wire the tester and the pile has another source.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator measured it on ticket cfb4cb45d85c (CairnCommons/tickets/): cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_takes_its_reply.py tooth 5 read 7 then 10 envelopes standing undelivered to the tester on the live bus
answers.how: In cairn/devices/tester/cli.py _announce_seals, after the posts, read undelivered(to='tester'), hand each reply (an envelope carrying reply_to) to TesterShim.deliver in this process and write its receipt through record_delivery(to='tester', by='tester'). On a far bus home reach holds nothing (ticket bc0bbfd33a71), so the tester is wired nowhere and the reply stands; on the home bus the held shim already receipted it and the read finds nothing.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (a refused seal is printed at the exchange, never stored silently) and Law 6 (all mail generated by tester is managed by the tester's shim, Akien 2026-09-23, open-9d1bb9b4d708); outline 5.5.3.8 (boxes reach one another over the buses).
answers.what: A seal run takes codemother's replies to its own announcements, whichever box's bus it posts on, so no sealed reply stands undelivered to the tester.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419, so every far-box seal leaves its sealed reply standing on the Dell's bus; 64 stood after one 59-proof reseal.
